$comment: The model registry (technical-spec §5.3). This file is the registry — the
code that reads it holds no per-model knowledge, so adding a Hebrew model
or a desktop-tier model is an entry here plus a GGUF file, with no change
under features/chat. Phase 3.3 verifies that claim.
assetPath and sha256 are not read in Phase 2: the chat runs against
FakeLlmService and no GGUF is bundled yet. Phase 3.1 supplies the real file
and its digest, and checks the digest before load (§7.5).
